reason: The README describes a bridge plugin that accepts chat images, sends them to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for description, and forwards the resulting text to a text-only model.

summaries.zh: 该插件将聊天中粘贴或拖入的图片发送到配置的兼容 OpenAI API 的视觉服务，生成文字描述后转交给文本模型处理。
summaries.en: This plugin sends images pasted or dragged into chat to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision service, then forwards the resulting descriptions to a text-only model.

capabilities: Accepts pasted or dragged images in chat messages
Sends image content to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API
Replaces image blocks with generated text descriptions before forwarding requests to a target text model
Stores and resolves an API credential through the host credentials mechanism
